user.title: Pool IQ chlorinator
user.description: Connects to the Pool IQ cloud and polls your salt chlorinator. The device ID is the controller's 12-character ID (such as 0070XXXXXXXX), shown in the Pool IQ app. Enter the username and password supplied by Pool IQ Hub. Leave the backend host as it is.
